info.title: Dolibarr Universal API
info.description: Dolibarr is an open-source ERP and CRM suite for managing business operations such as users, company setup, agenda events, categories, documents, and other enabled Dolibarr modules through its REST API.

get.description: Retrieves an agenda event from Dolibarr.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Dolibarr agenda event ID.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
